claims.statement: The project requires Node >=24.22.1 <25 and pins pnpm 11.24.0 as its package manager.
pnpm-workspace.yaml allows esbuild, lefthook and the embedded Postgres platform packages to run install scripts.

pnpm db:dev runs an embedded Postgres in the foreground, creating the cluster only on first run and the ta_web database if missing, warning when DATABASE_URL is set, and printing Postgres logs only with --verbose.
When pnpm db:dev fails to start, it stops Postgres and notes that a stale postmaster.pid from a hard shutdown can be removed if no other Postgres is running.

The package scripts define dev, build, start, lint, format, typecheck, the test suites including test:lhci and test:import, review:release, seed:e2e, db:dev, data:refresh with data:quests as its alias, data:dungeon-notes, links:legacy, urls:map, the import scripts (guides, Dofus guides, checklists, checklist cards, achievements, achievement prose, Alineamiento achievements, pages, section pages, inventory, delta, golden refresh), fix:achievements, the guides:* maintenance scripts including guides:summary-text, seed:site-copy, panel:block-thumbs, media:sizes, zones:backgrounds, migrate, migrate:create, payload, generate:types, generate:importmap and redirects:stubs, with build raising the Node heap to 8000 MB.

.env.example documents that an empty DATABASE_URL uses the embedded database, PAYLOAD_SECRET is mandatory, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is required in production, and media goes to ./media without the four S3 variables.
Schema push is used only under next dev; other contexts use committed migrations.
.nvmrc selects Node 24.

pnpm data:refresh, with pnpm data:quests as its old name, runs the DofusDB refresh with payload run, writing quests, items, monsters, achievements, sub-areas, dungeons and NPCs with their images to the DATABASE_URL database, or the pnpm db:dev database when DATABASE_URL is empty, and ends with the dungeon report of how each dungeon note matched.

pnpm import:guides imports Squarespace quest pages from the migration inventory into quest-guides as drafts with their images in media, defaulting to the five demo guides and writing to the DATABASE_URL database or the pnpm db:dev one when it is empty.
A full pnpm data:refresh run brings about 2,000 quests, the whole monster catalog of about 5,000 and the whole item catalog of about 21,500 items.
pnpm data:refresh writes 8 rows at a time by default, and DOFUSDB_WRITE_CONCURRENCY changes that number.
The DofusDB client used by pnpm data:quests retries requests that fail with a network error or HTTP 429, 502, 503 or 504.

pnpm test:lhci runs scripts/lhci.ts, which measures the production build on port 3110, or the port LHCI_PORT names, with its own ta_web_lhci database and needs Playwright's Chromium unless CHROME_PATH names another browser.
Under pnpm dev the /sistema catalog renders every DESIGN.md component in the five themes and both modes, ?tema= and ?modo= keep one section, and production answers 404.
Feature PRs leave openwiki/ alone; a daily scheduled task refreshes the wiki.
pnpm media:sizes regenerates missing media sizes and takes --remote and --production flags passed through to the script.
The project MCP configuration declares the Neon, Cloudflare and next-devtools servers, with next-devtools pinned to an exact version.
With APP_ENV=dev every response carries X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow and robots.txt disallows crawling.
pnpm import:achievements, pnpm fix:achievements and pnpm guides:backfill are payload run scripts that pass their flags through and only count or report without --apply.
pnpm import:dofus-guides is a payload run script that passes its flags through, only counts without --apply, and reads local HTML files with --from.

pnpm import:checklists, pnpm import:checklist-cards and pnpm import:achievement-prose are payload run scripts that pass their flags through and only count without --apply, and pnpm redirects:stubs rewrites the stubs section of the legacy redirect table.
pnpm data:dungeon-notes prints only the dungeon report, without DofusDB downloads or writes, and can run against dev through railway run.

pnpm data:refresh leaves a row in «Refrescos de datos», does nothing when another refresh is running, takes --schedule from the weekly Railway cron, and exits 1 when the refresh fails or a row could not be saved.
pnpm import:pages brings Torre's loose Squarespace pages into pages, reading saved HTML with --from and only counting without --apply.

pnpm seed:site-copy writes the built-in text only into empty fields of «Ajustes del sitio», «Portada e índices» and «Navegación», so a rerun changes nothing, and lists what it would do without --apply.
pnpm panel:block-thumbs captures each frame of the «Bloques del panel» group of /sistema in Arcano dark as a 480 by 320 WebP in public/img/panel/bloques and needs the app running.
The guides:rewards, guides:rewards-dofusdb, guides:reward-typos and guides:shown-items scripts are payload run maintenance scripts for quest guides that pass their flags through.
pnpm import:section-pages is a payload run script that passes its flags through, reads saved HTML with --from and only counts without --apply.

pnpm zones:backgrounds is a payload run script that lists the subareas published pages use without a background and fills them with --apply, refusing a remote database without --remote and production without --production.
MEDIA_STATIC_DIR picks another upload folder than ./media without R2, and the E2E and Lighthouse CI servers use media/test/<database>, one folder per test database.
.env.example documents TWITCH_LIVE_URL, where off never asks the live worker, and UMAMI_HOST with UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID, which turn analytics on only together and never in the dev environment.
LHCI_PORT, read only from the process environment, changes the port pnpm test:lhci measures from the default 3110.
pnpm achievements:alineamiento creates the missing Alineamiento achievement pages «En preparación» with Torre's slug and prose after pnpm data:refresh, only counting without --apply.
pnpm import:inventory, pnpm import:delta and pnpm import:golden-refresh are the delta import commands, and import:golden-refresh writes to no database and uploads nothing.

pnpm guides:summary-text rewrites the summary text of imported guides from the saved inventory pages, changing a field only while it holds what the last import wrote, and only lists changes without --apply.
pnpm links:legacy and pnpm urls:map are payload run scripts that pass their flags through.
.env.example lists E2E_ANALYTICS_PORT, the port of the second pnpm test:e2e server with Umami on, defaulting to E2E_PORT + 2.
